dict.string: ProLight requests access to your device's camera solely for diagnostic debugging purposes. This access enables our team to investigate and resolve any potential issues you may encounter while using the app. Rest assured that no images or videos will be captured or stored during this process.

To provide accurate local weather information and an 'Around Me' map view, ProLight needs access to your device's location when the app is in use. This allows us to deliver personalized weather forecasts and show nearby points of interest on the map based on your current location. Your location data is used solely within the app and is never shared with third parties.

ProLight requests access to your device's photo library so you can easily send us screenshots of any issues or bugs you encounter while using the app for diagnostic debugging purposes. We appreciate your help in improving our app's performance. Rest assured that we only access the photos you explicitly choose to share with us, and your media remains confidential.

ProLight requests access to your device's microphone solely for diagnostic debugging purposes. This access enables our team to investigate and resolve any potential issues you may encounter while using the app. Rest assured that no images or videos will be captured or stored during this process.
